environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running Amazon Linux 2 in VPC subnet-0a1b2c3d with public IP. Security group sg-0xff allows inbound 0.0.0.0/0 on port 8080. No ALB or reverse proxy in front. Instance profile has AdministratorAccess policy attached. Node.js 14.x process runs as root. No network ACL restrictions beyond default allow-all. CloudWatch agent installed but only collecting disk metrics.
